tile.grid_basis: OS National Grid aligned 5 km download tiles
tile.binding_basis: Carried-forward accepted target BNG position; this source window corroborates the 5 km OS-grid-aligned GeoTIFF supply model but does not independently expose a tile-specific survey row.

field_evidence.dataset_identity: Official Environment Agency dataset metadata and identifier.
field_evidence.tile_supply: Official metadata states GeoTIFF rasters are supplied in 5 km zipfiles aligned to the OS Grid.
field_evidence.resolution: Official metadata states 25 cm, 50 cm, 1 m and 2 m products depending on survey.
field_evidence.date: Official metadata exposes revision 2024-07-19 and archive period 1996-12-01 through 2024-04-18; exact target-tile survey date requires the separate metadata index catalogue.
field_evidence.license: Official metadata identifies Open Government Licence and no public access constraints.
field_evidence.vertical_reference: Official metadata states metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn.
